import json, re, tomllib
from collections import Counter
from nuka.editor.app import ActionError
cat = tomllib.load(open(r'${scenario_dir}/../../assets/editor/actions.toml', 'rb'))
kinds = {'read', 'view', 'edit', 'sim', 'file', 'process', 'app'}
own = {a['id']: a for a in app.actions.list() if not a['owner'] or a['owner'].startswith('nuka.')}
missing, stale = sorted(set(own) - set(cat)), sorted(set(cat) - set(own))
assert not missing and not stale, (missing, stale)
bad = [k for k, e in cat.items() if e.get('kind') not in kinds or not e.get('summary') or 'returns' not in e]
assert not bad, bad
for k, e in cat.items():
    if 'example' in e:
        json.loads(e['example'])
    for name, text in e.get('args', {}).items():
        assert not re.search(r'(^|, )\?(,|$)', text), (k, name, text)
    assert own[k]['kind'] == e['kind'] and own[k]['summary'] == e['summary'], (k, own[k])
h = app.actions.run('action.help', id='file.import')
assert h['kind'] == 'edit' and h['owner'] == '' and h['args']['path'].startswith('string'), h
assert json.loads(h['example'])['mode'] == 'add' and h['returns'] and 'enabled' in h, h
try:
    app.actions.run('action.help', id='no.such_action')
    raise AssertionError('help on an unknown id ran')
except ActionError as e:
    assert 'no.such_action' in str(e), e
print('CATALOG', len(own), dict(Counter(e['kind'] for e in cat.values())))

ctx = app._extensions._loaded['hello_py'][1]
ctx.actions.register('hello_py.bare', 'Bare', lambda: 1)
try:
    ctx.actions.register('hello_py.bad', 'Bad', lambda: 1, doc={'kind': 'everything'})
    raise AssertionError('a doc of an unknown kind registered')
except RuntimeError as e:
    assert 'cannot register' in str(e), e
ext = {a['id']: a for a in app.actions.list() if a['owner'] == 'hello_py'}
assert set(ext) == {'hello_py.greet', 'hello_py.bare'}, ext
assert ext['hello_py.greet']['kind'] == 'view' and ext['hello_py.greet']['summary'].startswith('Shows'), ext
assert ext['hello_py.bare']['kind'] == 'process' and ext['hello_py.bare']['summary'] == '', ext
h = app.actions.run('action.help', id='hello_py.greet')
assert h['args'] == {'fail': 'bool, fail on purpose, default false'} and h['returns'] == '{count, text}', h
assert app.actions.run('hello_py.greet')['count'] == 1
log = app.actions.run('extensions.log', id='hello_py')
assert 'is not read, view' in log, log
print('EXT DOCS', sorted(ext))
